messages.content: Summarize the text in one sentence of at most 25 words. Plain text only, no preamble, no bullet points.

Version 2.4 of the CLI adds a --dry-run flag to every write command, removes the deprecated sync subcommand, and fixes a race that corrupted the cache when two instances started at once. Upgrading requires no config changes.

response.text: Version 2.4 of the CLI introduces a --dry-run flag, removes the sync subcommand, and fixes a cache corruption issue without requiring config changes.
